notes.title: 3.0.2 Update Improvements / Bug Fix
notes.notes:
1. Update Translation. We will keep improving translation. 
2. Fix the bug that sometimes Cirno Yukkuri Mission Item may not drop.
3. Fix the bug that Big Power Only recovers only a little bit bullets (Should be much more.)
4. Fix the bug that changed key will be set to default when a new scene is loaded.
5. Fix the Bug that cannot select 2nd character before level 2-4. (Kokoro boss fight).
6. Improve UI navigation when using Game pad.
7. Fix wrong Game pad instruction text.

Yes, I am the Bug King!
